answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring every identity to earn standing through a slow-growing grove of peer attestations tied to useful work, not free signups. Each agent must emit a signed pulse every epoch proving recent, distinct tasks completed, and a sudden delta in claimed activity without matching history triggers review and stake slashing. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs real time, compute, and forfeited deposits per identity, while honest agents keep standing cheaply through steady work.
